rules.name: recon-snapshot-varchar-overflow-dev-uat
rules.sql: SELECT s.table_name, s.column_name, s.character_maximum_length AS snapshot_len, d.character_maximum_length AS source_len FROM information_schema.columns s JOIN information_schema.columns d ON d.table_schema = 'opera' AND d.table_name = 'deal_ticket_table' AND d.column_name = s.column_name WHERE s.table_schema = 'opera' AND s.table_name IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot', 'recon_traders_snapshot') AND s.data_type = 'character varying' AND s.character_maximum_length IS NOT NULL AND (d.character_maximum_length IS NULL OR s.character_maximum_length < d.character_maximum_length) ORDER BY s.table_name, s.column_name

SELECT s.table_name, s.column_name, s.character_maximum_length AS snapshot_len, d.character_maximum_length AS source_len FROM information_schema.columns s JOIN information_schema.columns d ON d.table_schema = 'opera' AND d.table_name = 'deal_ticket_table' AND d.column_name = s.column_name WHERE s.table_schema = 'opera' AND s.table_name IN ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'recon_actual_snapshot', 'recon_traders_snapshot') AND s.data_type = 'character varying' AND s.character_maximum_length IS NOT NULL AND (d.character_maximum_length IS NULL OR s.character_maximum_length < d.character_maximum_length) ORDER BY s.table_name, s.column_name

SELECT max(length(trade_source)) AS max_trade_source, max(length(trade_category)) AS max_trade_category, max(length(prd_category)) AS max_prd_category, max(length(sw_id)) AS max_sw_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE length(trade_source) > 20 OR length(trade_category) > 20 OR length(prd_category) > 20 OR length(sw_id) > 20) AS rows_over_20 FROM opera.deal_ticket_table

SELECT max(length(trade_source)) AS max_trade_source, max(length(trade_category)) AS max_trade_category, max(length(prd_category)) AS max_prd_category, max(length(sw_id)) AS max_sw_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE length(trade_source) > 20 OR length(trade_category) > 20 OR length(prd_category) > 20 OR length(sw_id) > 20) AS rows_over_20 FROM opera.deal_ticket_table

SELECT col, val, len, business_unit, n FROM ( SELECT 'trade_source' AS col, trade_source AS val, length(trade_source) AS len, business_unit, count(*) AS n FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE length(trade_source) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 UNION ALL SELECT 'trade_category', trade_category, length(trade_category), business_unit, count(*) FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE length(trade_category) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 UNION ALL SELECT 'prd_category', prd_category, length(prd_category), business_unit, count(*) FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE length(prd_category) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 UNION ALL SELECT 'sw_id', sw_id, length(sw_id), business_unit, count(*) FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE length(sw_id) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ) x ORDER BY len DESC, col, business_unit LIMIT 100

SELECT col, val, len, business_unit, n FROM ( SELECT 'trade_source' AS col, trade_source AS val, length(trade_source) AS len, business_unit, count(*) AS n FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE length(trade_source) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 UNION ALL SELECT 'trade_category', trade_category, length(trade_category), business_unit, count(*) FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE length(trade_category) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 UNION ALL SELECT 'prd_category', prd_category, length(prd_category), business_unit, count(*) FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE length(prd_category) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 UNION ALL SELECT 'sw_id', sw_id, length(sw_id), business_unit, count(*) FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE length(sw_id) > 20 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ) x ORDER BY len DESC, col, business_unit LIMIT 100

SELECT p.view_type, p.published_run_id, p.published_at, CASE p.view_type WHEN 'SETTLE_PRICING' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id) WHEN 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id) WHEN 'TRADERS_PRICING' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_traders_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id) END AS snapshot_rows FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.business_unit = :bu AND p.settlement_date = :settleDate ORDER BY p.view_type

SELECT p.view_type, p.published_run_id, p.published_at, CASE p.view_type WHEN 'SETTLE_PRICING' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id) WHEN 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id) WHEN 'TRADERS_PRICING' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_traders_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id) END AS snapshot_rows FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.business_unit = :bu AND p.settlement_date = :settleDate ORDER BY p.view_type
